name: Veil Masquerade #13
description: A cloth figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Coins. Aperture: Slot. Ornament: Checkerboard. Palette: Lilac. Hem: Scalloped. Its hem is shared with 3 others in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
